title: Composing a function with encoded data
statement: Let $f$ be a function from finite Boolean strings to finite Boolean strings. Define its encoded composition on a finite Boolean string $w$ by decoding $w$ as $(x,b)$; if the decoding succeeds and the binary expansion of the natural number encoded by $b$ equals $b$, return the encoding of $(f(x),b)$, and otherwise return the empty string.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps finite Boolean strings to finite Boolean strings
